subject: Re: MAVE kickoff — status: baselines in, negatives matter
body:
Status update.

Done: Farah's Beam pipeline reproduces the paper's splits — we ran split_json_lines_main over both mave_positives.jsonl and mave_negatives.jsonl and the split counts match the published benchmark exactly. Nikhil's baseline is within 0.6 F1 of the published number, so milestone 2 is met early.

Risk/trade-off for the pilot: on our internal catalog vertical, precision drops harder than the benchmark suggested because our data has far fewer explicit negatives than MAVE's curated negative set. Without a negatives-mining pass, we're seeing ~4 points of precision loss on spot-checked attributes (brand, capacity). Nikhil wants two weeks to mine hard negatives from the vertical before the 05-15 pilot report; that would push the report to ~05-22 but make the numbers honest.

My rec: take the slip. A padded quality report will haunt us with the catalog teams.

Kaia
